claims.quote: Sawbwa resplendens is a small cyprinid endemic to Inlé Lake and its associated watershed in Shan State, eastern Myanmar.
Endemic to the isolated mountain lake of Inlé and associated watershed in Shan State, eastern Myanmar.
Lake Inle in Burma is a mountain lake located on the Shan Plateau about 900 meters above sea level; it is about 65 km long and 10-22 km wide.
